title: Verificar cierre exacto de fixed-generation attention
mission: Prove the complete lifecycle of machine-readable fixed-generation recovery semantics. An incomplete fixed-generation fixture must remain visible in fixed_generation_attention and never enter ordinary G+1 recovery; once its declared attention gate is actually satisfied, it must leave fixed_generation_attention without becoming eligible for ordinary G+1 recovery. Preserve normal next-generation recovery for retry-safe jobs and keep the test generic rather than hardcoding a production fixture id.
definition_of_done: A deterministic regression uses arbitrary fixture ids and a fixed_generation policy with fixed_generation=1 and attention_until collision_count>=4.
At collision_count<4, the fixture remains in fixed_generation_attention and is absent from ordinary recovery even if an invalid later-generation terminal projection exists.
At collision_count>=4 with terminal evidence, the fixture leaves fixed_generation_attention and remains absent from ordinary G+1 recovery.
An ordinary retry-safe control job still receives NEXT/G+1 recovery in the same test.
The regression is wired into the existing efficiency-ratchet CI or another equally binding bounded verifier.
The allocator/compiler contains no blacklist for the specific live race fixture and no Current, Human Accepted, Served or production /w authority is promoted.
